rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for gently persuading a person or animal to do something.

example.english: It took a little treat to coax the cat into the cage.
example.traditional: 我氹隻貓入籠，畀少少零食佢就肯喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tam3 zek3 maau1 jap6 lung4 bei2 siu2 siu2 ling4 sik6 keoi5 zau6 hang2 laa3

rows.traditional: 慢慢咁整 A 入 B
rows.jyutping: maan6 maan2 gam3 zing2 A jap6 B
rows.note: Use this when carefully working a person or object into a particular position or situation rather than persuading them with words.

example.english: The sofa is too big, so we need to coax it through the doorway slowly.
example.traditional: 張梳化太大，要慢慢咁整佢入門先得。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 so1 faa2 taai3 daai6 jiu3 maan6 maan2 gam3 zing2 keoi5 jap6 mun4 sin1 dak1
